snippet.title: Witz: AI Trivia Game - #buildwithgemini
snippet.description:
We’re excited to introduce our very first game app! 🎮✨

Powered by Gemini - This isn’t just any quiz game. Gemini creates questions in real-time, tailored to your choices! 💡

Challenge the World - Play against opponents globally or have fun with your friends. Experience the ultimate quiz adventure and see who’s the quiz master! 🌟

Download it here:  https://witz.loudsrl.com

#NewGame #QuizChallenge #buildwithgemini
